an6.60:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
an6.60:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā therā bhikkhū pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā maṇḍalamāle sannisinnā sannipatitā abhidhammakathaṃ kathenti.
an6.60:1.4: tatrasudaṃ āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathentānaṃ antarantarā kathaṃ opāteti.
an6.60:1.5: atha khe āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ cittaṃ hatthisāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
an6.60:1.6: “mā āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathentānaṃ antarantarā kathaṃ opātesi. kathāpariyosānaṃ āyasmā citto āgametūti.
an6.60:1.7: evaṃ vutte āyasmato cittassa hatthisāriputtassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an6.60:1.8: “mā āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ cittaṃ hatthisāriputtaṃ apasādesi. paṇḍito āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto.
an6.60:1.9: pahoti cāyasmā citto hatthisāriputto therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathetuṃ”ti.
an6.60:2.1: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso parassa cetopariyāyaṃ ajānantehi. (1)
an6.60:2.2: idhāvuso ekacco puggalo tāvadeva soratasorato hoti, nivātanivāto hoti, upasantupasanto hoti yāva satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhānīyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ.
an6.60:2.3: yato ca kho so vapakassateva satthārā, vapakassati garuṭṭhānīyehi sabrahmacārīhi. so saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rāpamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi.
an6.60:2.4: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākatassa bhassamanuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
an6.60:2.5: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an6.60:3.1: seyyathāpi āvuso goṇo kiṭṭhādo dāmena vā baddho vaje vā oruddho,
an6.60:3.2: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya: “na dānāya goṇo kiṭṭhādo punadeva kiṭṭhaṃ otarissatī”ti. sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyātī?
an6.60:3.4: ṭhānaṃ hetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ so goṇo kiṭṭhādo dāmaṃ vā chetvā vajaṃ vā bhinditvā punadeva kiṭṭhaṃ otareyyāti.
an6.60:3.5: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo tāvadeva soratasorato hoti nivātanivāto hoti upasantupasanto hoti yāva satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhānīyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ.
an6.60:3.6: yato ca kho so vapakassateva satthārā, vapakassati garuṭṭhanīyehi sabrahmacārīhi. so saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi.
an6.60:3.7: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākatassa bhassamanuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
an6.60:3.8: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati. (2)
an6.60:4.1: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an6.60:4.2: so lābhimhi paṭhamassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:4.4: seyyathāpi āvuso cātummahāpathe phullapūsitako devo vassanto rajaṃ antaradhāpeyya, cikkhallaṃ pātukareyya,
an6.60:4.5: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya: “na dānāmusmiṃ cātummahāpathe punadeva rajo pātu bhavissatī”ti. sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti.
an6.60:4.7: ṭhānaṃ hetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ amusmiṃ cātummahāpathe manussā vā atikkameyyuṃ, gopasu vā atikkameyyuṃ, vātātapo vā snehagataṃ pariyādiyeyya. atha punadeva rajo pātubhaveyyāti.
an6.60:4.8: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo vivicceva kāmehi [vivicca akusalehi dhammehi] …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an6.60:4.9: so lābhīmhi paṭhamassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:5.1: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an6.60:5.2: so lābhīmhi dutiyassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:5.4: seyyathāpi āvuso gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahantaṃ taḷākaṃ,
an6.60:5.5: tattha phullaphusitako devo vassanto sippisambukampi sakkharakaṭhalampi antaradhāpeyya,
an6.60:5.6: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya: nadānāmusmiṃ taḷāke punadeva sippisambukā vā sakkharakaṭhalā vā pātubhavissantīti. sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti.
an6.60:5.8: ṭhānaṃ hetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ amusmiṃ taḷāke manussā vā piveyyuṃ, gopasu vā piveyyuṃ, vātātapo vā snehagataṃ pariyādiyeyya, atha punadeva sippisambukāpi sakkharakaṭhalāpi pātubhaveyyunti.
an6.60:5.9: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an6.60:5.10: so lābhīmhi dutiyassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:6.1: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:6.2: so lābhīmhi tatiyassa jhānassāti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhī …pe…
an6.60:6.4: seyyathāpi āvuso purisaṃ paṇītabhojanaṃ bhuttāviṃ ābhidosiyaṃ bhojanaṃ nacchādeyya,
an6.60:6.5: yo nu ko āvuso evaṃ vadeyya “na dānāmuṃ purisaṃ punadeva bhojanaṃ chādessatī”ti. sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti.
an6.60:6.7: “ṭhānaṃ hetaṃ āvuso vijjati amuṃ hāvuso purisaṃ paṇītabhojanaṃ bhuttāviṃ yāvassa sā ojā kāye ṭhassati tāva na aññaṃ bhojanaṃ chādessati.
an6.60:6.8: yato ca khvassa sā ojā antaradhāyissati. atha punadeva taṃ bhojanaṃ chādeyyāti.
an6.60:6.9: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:6.10: so “lābhīmhi tatiyassa jhānassā”ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:7.1: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:7.2: so “lābhīmhi catutthassa jhānassā”ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:7.4: seyyathāpi āvuso pabbatasaṅkhepe udakarahado nivāto vigataūmako,
an6.60:7.5: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya: “na dānamusmiṃ udakarahade punadeva ūmī pātubhavissatī”ti. sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti.
an6.60:7.7: ṭhānaṃ hetaṃ āvuso vijjati yā puratthimāya disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi sā tasmiṃ udakarahade ūmiṃ janeyya, yā pacchimāya disāya āgaccheyya …pe… yā uttarāya disāya āgaccheyya …pe… yā dakkhiṇāya disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi sā tasmiṃ udakarahade ūmiṃ janeyyāti.
an6.60:7.8: evameva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an6.60:7.9: so “lābhīmhi catutthassa jhānassā”ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi …pe…
an6.60:8.1: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ ceto samādhiṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:8.2: so “lābhīmhi animittassa cetosamādhissā”ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi,
an6.60:8.3: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākatassa bhassamanuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
an6.60:8.4: so rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an6.60:8.5: seyyathāpi āvuso rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā caturaṅginiyā senāya addhānamaggapaṭipanno aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe ekarattivāsaṃ upagaccheyya,
an6.60:8.6: tattha hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena pattisaddena bheripaṇavasaṅkhatiṇavaninnādasaddena cīriliyasaddo antaradhāyeyya,
an6.60:8.7: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya: “na dānamusmiṃ vanasaṇḍe punadeva cīriliyasaddo pātubhavissatīti. sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyāti.
an6.60:8.9: ṭhānaṃ hetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ so rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā tamhā vanasaṇḍā pakkameyya, atha punadeva cīriliyasaddo pātubhaveyyāti.
an6.60:8.10: eva meva kho āvuso idhekacco puggalo sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an6.60:8.11: so “lābhīmhi animittassa cetosamādhissā”ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi,
an6.60:8.12: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākatassa bhassamanuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
an6.60:8.13: so rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati’ti.
an6.60:9.1: atha kho āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto aparena samayena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatti.
an6.60:9.2: atha kho cittassa hatthisāriputtassa sahāyakā bhikkhu yenāyasmā koṭṭhito tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an6.60:9.3: kinnu kho āyasmatā mahākoṭṭhitena citto hatthisāriputto cetasā ceto paricca vidito
an6.60:9.4: imāsaṃ ca imāsaṃ ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ citto hatthisāriputto lābhī, atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatīti.
an6.60:9.6: citto bhante hatthisāriputto imāsañca imāsañca vihārasamāsamāpattīnaṃ lābhī, atha ca pana sikkhā paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatī’ti.
an6.60:9.7: cetasā ceto paricca vidito me āvuso
an6.60:9.8: citto hatthisāriputto imāsañca imāsañca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī, atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatī’ti.
an6.60:9.10: “citto bhante hatthisāriputto imāsañca imāsañca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī, atha ca pana sikkhaṃpaccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatī”ti.
an6.60:10.1: atha kho cittassa hatthisāriputtassa sahāyakā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. etamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an6.60:10.2: citto bhante hatthisāriputto imāsañca imāsañca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī, atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto’ti.
an6.60:10.3: na bhikkhave citto ciraṃ sarissati nekkhammassā’ti.
an6.60:11.1: atha kho citto hatthisāriputto na viharasseva kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji.
an6.60:11.2: atha kho āyasmā citto hatthisāriputto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anāgāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
an6.60:11.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti abbhaññāsi.
an6.60:11.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā citto hatthisāriputto arahataṃ ahosī’ti.
